europe_now.title: European Union Deadlock on Russian Sanctions Rollover
europe_now.summary: Member states failed to reach an agreement regarding the extension of economic measures against Russia with only one day remaining before the deadline. The delay highlights ongoing diplomatic friction within the bloc over foreign policy decisions.
